about: The satellite engine's local control channel (spare-device satellites S1, 2026-10-13):
what the tray, the CLI (python -m satellite.client --status ...) and the installer
say to the engine running on the same machine. Implemented in satellite/control.py,
read by satellite/tests/test_control_protocol.py. A Windows satellite reuses the verbs
and the framing over its own transport (a named pipe), so it can test against this file.
Documented in docs/uml/satellite-protocol.md, 'The local control channel'.

transport.linux: AF_UNIX stream socket ~/.domovoi/control.sock, mode 0600 in a 0700 directory; a peer whose uid (SO_PEERCRED) is neither the engine's nor root is closed at once
transport.windows: named pipe \\.\pipe\domovoi-satellite-<user SID>:a protected DACL granting only that user, PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS, the first instance claimed with FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE; the engine closes a client whose process is another user's, and the client refuses a pipe served by another user's process (satellite/control_win.py)

framing.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, one object per line, terminated by \n
framing.response: exactly one line per request, in order: {"ok": true, "verb", "req"?, ...result} or {"ok": false, "verb", "req"?, "error": <code>, "message": <text for a person>}
framing.watch: after its response, the connection stays open and gets {"event": "status", ...status} whenever the status changes; requests may still be sent on it
framing.idle: a connection that is not watching is closed after 30 s without a request

verbs.watch: the status now, then an {"event": "status"} line on every change
verbs.mute: stop listening: the microphone is closed until unmute (kept across restarts)
verbs.volume: no argument: read; `level` 0-100 or `delta` -100..100: set; answers {volume}
verbs.code: the approval code while waiting for approval: {waiting, code}
verbs.logs-path: where the engine's log goes: {kind, path, hint}
verbs.identify: play the room chime now ("which room is this"); answers {room}
verbs.approve: run a pending action (the "ask me" permission): `action` = its id, or "all"
verbs.decline: drop a pending action: `action` = its id, or "all"

errors.bad_request: not a JSON object, no verb, or a line too long
errors.unknown_verb: a verb this engine doesn't have
errors.bad_argument: an argument missing, of the wrong type or out of range
errors.not_available: this engine can't do that here (no volume control, no chime)
errors.failed: the engine tried and it did not work (the message says why)

status.room: {id, name}: the room id it connects as and the name it was enrolled with
status.server: {url, host, fingerprint, pinned}: the core's socket URL, its host, the pinned fingerprint and whether one is pinned
status.dashboard: the dashboard to open (http://<core host>:6369), or null
status.reason: a short reason for offline / refused / unpinned, else null
status.volume: the last known output volume 0-100, or null
status.pending: [{id, kind, summary, details, received_at}] held for the person's OK ("ask me"); details lists every change, one line each, never shortened (an action that cannot be shown whole is not held)
status.battery: {percent, charging, on_power} on a device with a battery (the health sample's object), else null
status.version: the satellite code's version label (the hello's synced_sha), or null

connections.connecting: looking for the core or dialing it
connections.connected: a session is up: the core sent `ready`
connections.awaiting_approval: the core parked this device: type its code in the dashboard
connections.offline: the core can't be reached right now (reason says what failed)
connections.refused: the core refused this device (pairing rejected, another device has the room)
connections.unpinned: the core at the address could not prove the pinned identity

pending_kinds.update: new satellite code from the core (`upgrade`)
pending_kinds.restart: a restart the core asked for (`restart`, or a spoken "restart")
pending_kinds.config: settings pushed from the dashboard (`set_config`, ends in a restart)
pending_kinds.wake_word: a wake-word model pushed to this room (`set_wake_word`, ends in a restart)

pending.summary: the core asked for a restart

done.summary: the core asked for a restart
